title: Ashim's Food Canteen
text:
Asheems, or aseems as popularly known, is the ground floor canteen in Nehru Hall run by Mr. Ashim Bishal. It is popular for its wide and unique menu which has attracted a loyal following through the years. During the orientation program, students of Nehru are forbidden from eating here. Paytm money wallet and BHIM payment interface is accepted for payments. Contact no is 9593719333

Timing

The timings are (usually) from 4 PM to 2 AM although this has been known to fluctuate widely.

Popular items
The Ashim's canteen is known for its Chicken Tandoori, Chotai, and Poha, although other dishes are popular as well.

Menu

Ashim menu 1.jpg|Page 1
Ashim menu 2.jpg|Page 2

Employees
Familiar employees include Mr. Ashim, Mr. Bapun, and Mr. Subir.

Controversy
In 2013, certain groups complained against Mr. Ashim for his use of child labor at the canteen. Consequently, he was was forced to enroll the children in question in a nearby school.
